due_when.clears_when: A candidate review exists as a repeatable pass (a skill step or a scheduled report) that ranks prop-eligible legs from /api/bot/performance on totalPnlMeasured BESIDE pnlCoverage, applies the three prop filters - symbol eligibility, survival under the $150 daily / $4,700 static floor, and swap-drag-aware economics - and runs account_compat_matrix.py under breakout.yaml at the resulting concentration for anything that survives. Manual-bridge fit is recorded as an expected-fill-rate NOTE and must rank nothing (operator-corrected 2026-08-23); a pass that filters candidates on answer-rate does not close this row. It must carry an explicit 'the answer may be none' branch so it cannot become a search for a reason to add a leg - but that branch must be reached by the compat matrix rejecting candidates, never by an a-priori filter. Closed when a reader can see, from the record, which legs were considered for prop and why each was rejected.
